genuine_challenges_and_decisions.decision: Parent confirmed run root; read only the intended financials.md business file.

genuine_challenges_and_decisions.decision: Used Get-Content for permitted reads, then a dedicated owned Python script for reproducible analysis.

genuine_challenges_and_decisions.decision: Narrow escalation executed only the owned stage2 script; authorized outputs saved successfully.

genuine_challenges_and_decisions.decision: Preserve gross charge, releases and rounded precision; do not double-count or assign residual to Blackwell.

genuine_challenges_and_decisions.challenge: Anonymous customer order differs across years.
genuine_challenges_and_decisions.decision: Compute largest-ranked share movement only; do not infer customer identities or continuity.

genuine_challenges_and_decisions.decision: Follow company FCF definition including principal payments and cash-flow-basis capital return.

genuine_challenges_and_decisions.decision: Use recast HQ comparatives; label FY2027 outlook historical and non-GAAP comparison break.
